38.text: And Jesus having turned, and having beheld them following, saith to them, 'What seek ye?' and they said to them, 'Rabbi, (which is, being interpreted, Teacher,) where remainest thou?'

39.text: He saith to them, 'Come and see;' they came, and saw where he doth remain, and with him they remained that day and the hour was about the tenth.

42.text: and he brought him unto Jesus: and having looked upon him, Jesus saith, 'Thou art Simon, the son of Jonas, thou shalt be called Cephas,' (which is interpreted, A rock.)

43.text: On the morrow, he willed to go forth to Galilee, and he findeth Philip, and saith to him, 'Be following me.'

47.text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming unto him, and he saith concerning him, 'Lo, truly an Israelite, in whom guile is not;'

48.text: Nathanael saith to him, 'Whence me dost thou know?' Jesus answered and said to him, 'Before Philip's calling thee — thou being under the fig-tree — I saw thee.'

50.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Because I said to thee, I saw thee under the fig-tree, thou dost believe; greater things than these thou shalt see;'

51.text: and he saith to him, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, henceforth ye shall see the heaven opened, and the messengers of God going up and coming down upon the Son of Man.'

4.text: Jesus saith to her, 'What — to me and to thee, woman? not yet is mine hour come.'

7.text: Jesus saith to them, 'Fill the water-jugs with water;' and they filled them — unto the brim;

8.text: and he saith to them, 'Draw out, now, and bear to the director of the apartment;' and they bare.

16.text: and to those selling the doves he said, 'Take these things hence; make not the house of my Father a house of merchandise.'

19.text: Jesus answered and said to them, 'Destroy this sanctuary, and in three days I will raise it up.'

3.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Verily, verily, I say to thee, If any one may not be born from above, he is not able to see the reign of God;'

5.text: Jesus answered, 'Verily, verily, I say to thee, If any one may not be born of water, and the Spirit, he is not able to enter into the reign of God;

6.text: that which hath been born of the flesh is flesh, and that which hath been born of the Spirit is spirit.

7.text: 'Thou mayest not wonder that I said to thee, It behoveth you to be born from above;

8.text: the Spirit where he willeth doth blow, and his voice thou dost hear, but thou hast not known whence he cometh, and whither he goeth; thus is every one who hath been born of the Spirit.'

10.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Thou art the teacher of Israel — and these things thou dost not know!

11.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to thee — What we have known we speak, and what we have seen we testify, and our testimony ye do not receive;

12.text: if the earthly things I said to you, and ye do not believe, how, if I shall say to you the heavenly things, will ye believe?

13.text: and no one hath gone up to the heaven, except he who out of the heaven came down — the Son of Man who is in the heaven.

14.text: 'And as Moses did lift up the serpent in the wilderness, so it behoveth the Son of Man to be lifted up,

15.text: that every one who is believing in him may not perish, but may have life age-during,

16.text: for God did so love the world, that His Son — the only begotten — He gave, that every one who is believing in him may not perish, but may have life age-during.

17.text: For God did not send His Son to the world that he may judge the world, but that the world may be saved through him;

18.text: he who is believing in him is not judged, but he who is not believing hath been judged already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

19.text: 'And this is the judgment, that the light hath come to the world, and men did love the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil;

20.text: for every one who is doing wicked things hateth the light, and doth not come unto the light, that his works may not be detected;

21.text: but he who is doing the truth doth come to the light, that his works may be manifested, that in God they are having been wrought.'

7.text: there cometh a woman out of Samaria to draw water. Jesus saith to her, 'Give me to drink;'

10.text: Jesus answered and said to her, 'If thou hadst known the gift of God, and who it is who is saying to thee, Give me to drink, thou wouldest have asked him, and he would have given thee living water.'

13.text: Jesus answered and said to her, 'Every one who is drinking of this water shall thirst again;

14.text: but whoever may drink of the water that I will give him, may not thirst — to the age; and the water that I will give him shall become in him a well of water, springing up to life age-during.'

16.text: Jesus saith to her, 'Go, call thy husband, and come hither;'

17.text: the woman answered and said, 'I have not a husband.' Jesus saith to her, 'Well didst thou say — A husband I have not;

18.text: for five husbands thou hast had, and, now, he whom thou hast is not thy husband; this hast thou said truly.'

21.text: Jesus saith to her, 'Woman, believe me, that there doth come an hour, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, shall ye worship the Father;

22.text: ye worship what ye have not known; we worship what we have known, because the salvation is of the Jews;

23.text: but, there cometh an hour, and it now is, when the true worshippers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father also doth seek such to worship him;

24.text: God [is] a Spirit, and those worshipping Him, in spirit and truth it doth behove to worship.'

26.text: Jesus saith to her, 'I am [he], who am speaking to thee.'

32.text: and he said to them, 'I have food to eat that ye have not known.'

34.text: Jesus saith to them, 'My food is, that I may do the will of Him who sent me, and may finish His work;

35.text: do not say that it is yet four months, and the harvest cometh; lo, I say to you, Lift up your eyes, and see the fields, that they are white unto harvest already.

36.text: 'And he who is reaping doth receive a reward, and doth gather fruit to life age-during, that both he who is sowing and he who is reaping may rejoice together;

37.text: for in this the saying is the true one, that one is the sower and another the reaper.

38.text: I sent you to reap that on which ye have not laboured; others laboured, and ye into their labour have entered.

48.text: Jesus then said unto him, 'If signs and wonders ye may not see, ye will not believe.'

50.text: Jesus saith to him, 'Be going on; thy son doth live.' And the man believed the word that Jesus said to him, and was going on,

53.text: then the father knew that [it was] in that hour in which Jesus said to him — 'Thy son doth live,' and he himself believed, and his whole house;

6.text: him Jesus having seen lying, and having known that he is already a long time, he saith to him, 'Dost thou wish to become whole?'

8.text: Jesus saith to him, 'Rise, take up thy couch, and be walking;'

14.text: After these things, Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said to him, 'Lo, thou hast become whole; sin no more, lest something worse may happen to thee.'

17.text: And Jesus answered them, 'My Father till now doth work, and I work;'

19.text: Jesus therefore responded and said to them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, The Son is not able to do anything of himself, if he may not see the Father doing anything; for whatever things He may do, these also the Son in like manner doth;

20.text: for the Father doth love the Son, and doth shew to him all things that He himself doth; and greater works than these He will shew him, that ye may wonder.

21.text: 'For, as the Father doth raise the dead, and doth make alive, so also the Son doth make alive whom he willeth;

22.text: for neither doth the Father judge any one, but all the judgment He hath given to the Son,

23.text: that all may honour the Son according as they honour the Father; he who is not honouring the Son, doth not honour the Father who sent him.

24.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to you — He who is hearing my word, and is believing Him who sent me, hath life age-during, and to judgment he doth not come, but hath passed out of the death to the life.

25.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to you — There cometh an hour, and it now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God, and those having heard shall live;

26.text: for, as the Father hath life in himself, so He gave also to the Son to have life in himself,

27.text: and authority He gave him also to do judgment, because he is Son of Man.

28.text: 'Wonder not at this, because there doth come an hour in which all those in the tombs shall hear his voice,

29.text: and they shall come forth; those who did the good things to a rising again of life, and those who practised the evil things to a rising again of judgment.

30.text: 'I am not able of myself to do anything; according as I hear I judge, and my judgment is righteous, because I seek not my own will, but the will of the Father who sent me.

31.text: 'If I testify concerning myself, my testimony is not true;

32.text: another there is who is testifying concerning me, and I have known that the testimony that he doth testify concerning me is true;

33.text: ye have sent unto John, and he hath testified to the truth.

34.text: 'But I do not receive testimony from man, but these things I say that ye may be saved;

35.text: he was the burning and shining lamp, and ye did will to be glad, for an hour, in his light.

36.text: 'But I have the testimony greater than John's, for the works that the Father gave me, that I might finish them, the works themselves that I do, they testify concerning me, that the Father hath sent me.

37.text: 'And the Father who sent me Himself hath testified concerning me; ye have neither heard His voice at any time, nor His appearance have ye seen;

38.text: and His word ye have not remaining in you, because whom He sent, him ye do not believe.

39.text: 'Ye search the Writings, because ye think in them to have life age-during, and these are they that are testifying concerning me;

40.text: and ye do not will to come unto me, that ye may have life;

41.text: glory from man I do not receive,

42.text: but I have known you, that the love of God ye have not in yourselves.

43.text: 'I have come in the name of my Father, and ye do not receive me; if another may come in his own name, him ye will receive;

44.text: how are ye able — ye — to believe, glory from one another receiving, and the glory that [is] from God alone ye seek not?

45.text: 'Do not think that I will accuse you unto the Father; there is who is accusing you, Moses — in whom ye have hoped;

46.text: for if ye were believing Moses, ye would have been believing me, for he wrote concerning me;

47.text: but if his writings ye believe not, how shall ye believe my sayings?'
